seo.description: Explore the deep history of Earth's crust through interactive geological strata maps and field guides.

hero.title:
Layers hold
tales of time
hero.text: Every layer of sediment records a chapter of our planet, from ancient seabeds to drifting ash.

steps-course.title:
Read the ground
like a book
steps-course.text: Eight short chapters, from a pebble in your hand to four billion years of Earth history.

items.title: How layers form
items.text: Rivers, seas and volcanoes lay down sediment grain by grain. 12 min.

items.title: Reading a rock face
items.text: Colour, grain size and fossils tell you where a layer came from. 18 min.

items.title: Deep time
items.text: Put millions of years on a scale you can feel. 15 min.

items.title: Faults and folds
items.text: Why layers tilt, break and bend, and what that says about the forces below. 20 min.

items.title: Fossils as clocks
items.text: Date a layer in the field with an index fossil, no lab needed. 16 min.

gallery-guides.title: Pocket guides for the trail
gallery-guides.text: Download a guide, take it offline and match the cliff to what is in your hand.

items.title: Ammonites and shells
items.text: Fossils. Spot, name and date marine fossils.

items.title: Canyons and cliffs
items.text: Landscapes. Read a valley wall, layer by layer.

cards-layers.title: Peel back the crust
cards-layers.text: What each layer is made of, and how long ago it was laid down.

items.title: Topsoil and loess
items.text: 0 to 10 ka. Wind-blown dust and roots: the youngest layer.

items.title: Glacial till
items.text: 10 to 120 ka. Clay and boulders dropped by melting ice sheets.

items.title: Chalk and limestone
items.text: 66 to 145 Ma. Sea shells pressed into white rock.

items.title: Red sandstone
items.text: 200 to 250 Ma. Ancient desert dunes, still slanted by the wind.

items.title: Volcanic ash band
items.text: 300 Ma. One eruption, a few centimetres thick, that dates the rest.

items.title: Granite basement
items.text: 1.7 Ga. Crystalline rock that cooled before any layer above it.

paint-strata.title:
Pick a layer,
see its colour
paint-strata.text: Tap a stratum to repaint the rocks in its colour.

plans-field.title: Choose how deep you go
plans-field.text: Start free. Upgrade for offline guides and live tours.
